This pilot assesses executability and cost of an existing ordinary filesystem consumer; it does not measure an effect or complete the performance gate. Use maintained //test/benchmarks/fs:rubydev_test BenchmarkRubyNoOpTest/page_cache.dirty/filesystem.bindfs at1x, plus //test/benchmarks/base:startup_test BenchmarkStartupEmpty at1x. Ruby's maintained no-op workload is the Stripe benchmark described in source. Its canonical FSBenchmark copies files before ResetTimer and times container.Exec in a fresh container, preserving first-exec path work. Select dirty bindfs only: no host cache dropping, tmpfs/fuse or clean-cache matrix. Ordinary systrap runtimes explicitly use directfs=false, debug=false and network=sandbox. No physical VFIO/TPU, device-path performance or ARM claim follows.
